testsuite.name: com.chimali.fido2.ctap2.Ctap2MakeCredentialHandlerValidationTest

testcase.name: actual CBOR rejects explicit null and undefined extension policy values before dispatch()
empty decoded map returns invalid CBOR and releases ceremony lock()
actual CBOR rejects malformed options map and implemented boolean fields before dispatch()
CTAP required UV is preserved in registration options()
actual CBOR MakeCredential key six delivers credProtect to registration()
invalid credProtect extension fails before registration dispatch()
named request keys options and PRF extension forms decode before algorithm rejection()
FIDO exception families map to CTAP statuses and always release the lock()
COSE algorithm values wrapping to implemented identifiers fail before dispatch()
[1] success
[2] malformed
[3] failure
[4] cancelled
active ceremony returns channel busy without decoding request()
successful registration dispatch encodes the provided attestation bytes()
unsupported algorithm returns unsupported algorithm and releases lock()
registration failures map storage authorization and other errors to CTAP statuses()
malformed request shapes return protocol errors at each required field boundary()
partial request parsing erases fallback owners when later algorithm validation fails()
empty or wrong command returns invalid CBOR without acquiring ceremony lock()
request without a valid algorithm returns missing parameter and releases lock()
